cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from protocol import parse_request
import main
raw={'cases':[{'initial':[['::/0',0],['2001:db8::/64',0],['2001:db8::1/128',7]],
        'transactions':[[['erase','2001:db8::1/128']]],
        'bursts':[{'version':0,'repeat':9,'addresses':['2001:db8::','2001:db8::1','2001:db8::2','::']},
                  {'version':1,'repeat':8,'addresses':['2001:db8::','2001:db8::1','2001:db8::2','::']}],
        'cache_pages':3,'costs':{'hit':2,'miss':17,'decode':[0,0,1]}}]}
cases=parse_request(json.dumps(raw).encode())
case=cases[0]
versions=main.build_versions(case)
runs=[main.compute_runs(v) for v in versions]
plan_data=[]
for i,(s,h) in enumerate(runs):
    bursts=[(case['bursts'][j][1],case['bursts'][j][2]) for j in range(len(case['bursts'])) if case['bursts'][j][0]==i]
    plan_data.append({'starts':s,'hops':h,'bursts':bursts})
lay=main.fallback_plan(plan_data,case['cache_pages'],case['costs'])
print(json.dumps(lay,indent=1))
EOF
